# KINGAI OS

Official OS site: https://os.kingai.work
KINGAI main site: https://www.kingai.work
Repository: https://github.com/kingaiwork/KINGAIOS
Documentation: docs/INDEX.md
Business and partnership: vip@kingai.work

Project: KINGAI OS
Architecture: D4 Sovereign Distributed Intelligence Operating System
Status: Developer Foundation / Pre-Alpha
Base technology: Ubuntu 26.04 LTS technology base with KINGAI-owned intelligence, governance, security, update, desktop and distribution layers
Primary principles: AI-native, Agent-native, Local-first, Secure-by-default, Model-neutral, Cloud-neutral, Controlled-evolution

Official editions:
- KINGAI OS Server
- KINGAI OS Desktop
- KINGAI OS IoT / Edge

Desktop experiences:
- KINGAI Intelligence
- KINGAI Flow
- KINGAI Classic

Core layers:
- KINGAI Intelligence
- KINGAI Memory
- KINGAI Governance
- KINGAI Agent Runtime
- KINGAI Model Fabric
- KINGAI Security
- KINGAI Trust and Update Chain
- KINGAI Desktop Experience

Execution adapters may include:
- Native runtime
- OpenClaw
- MCP
- Codex
- Browser runtime
- Rootless containers
- Isolated VM/MicroVM backends

Distribution policy:
- Source code and metadata: GitHub
- Large artifacts at or above 2 GiB: KINGAI object storage / Cloudflare R2
- Public download namespace: https://os.kingai.work/download
- Updates: https://os.kingai.work/updates
- Repository: https://os.kingai.work/repo

Legal note:
KINGAI OS is independently developed on the Ubuntu 26.04 LTS technology base and follows applicable open-source licenses and trademark rules.
